title: 设计令牌
Design tokens
scenario: 修改一个设计令牌，观察同一预览中的三个元素共同变化。
Change one token and observe three preview elements update together.

title: 颜色与语义色
Color and semantic colors
scenario: 正常、成功、警告和错误信息同时具备文字与颜色。
Normal, success, warning and error states use both words and colors.

initial_probe.scope: static/semantic specimen; no interaction pass claimed

title: 排版层级
Typography
scenario: 调整正文大小，标题与说明仍保留明确层级。
Change body size while headings and captions keep a clear hierarchy.

title: 间距系统
Spacing
scenario: 用实际测量值调整组间留白，不把黄金比例当作美观保证。
Adjust measured spacing without treating the golden ratio as a guarantee of beauty.

title: 圆角与边框
Radius and borders
scenario: 比较同一边框在矩形、适度圆角和胶囊形上的差异。
Compare the same border with square, modestly rounded and pill shapes.

title: 图标
Icons
scenario: 相同 24×24 图标网格；纯图标不加常驻框，聚焦仍有轮廓。
One 24×24 icon grid: no permanent frames, but visible keyboard focus.

title: 阴影与层级
Elevation
scenario: 层级由容器背景、边线和阴影共同表示；不依赖单一阴影。
Surface, outline and shadow combine to express elevation.

initial_probe.scope: static/semantic specimen; no interaction pass claimed

title: 栅格
Grid
scenario: 12 列栅格中展示 3/6/3 与 4/8 两种真实跨度。
A 12-column grid demonstrates 3/6/3 and 4/8 spans.

initial_probe.scope: static/semantic specimen; no interaction pass claimed

title: 断点
Breakpoints
scenario: 改变模拟视口宽度，导航在三种断点状态间切换。
Change a simulated viewport to switch between three breakpoint states.

title: 响应式容器
Responsive container
scenario: 容器宽度改变时，卡片自动从一行变成多行。
Cards wrap as the containing surface changes width.

title: 动效
Motion
scenario: 同一移动交互分别展示普通与减少动效状态。
One movement demonstrates normal and reduced-motion states.

title: 焦点样式
Focus indication
scenario: 通过 Tab 顺序访问三个按钮；焦点不能只靠鼠标悬停。
Tab through three actions; focus is independent of pointer hover.

title: 密度与尺寸
Density and sizing
scenario: 密度改变作用于整个操作组，不混用同组按钮高度。
Density affects the entire action group, not individual button heights.

title: 主题
Themes
scenario: 只切换此示例的表面主题，观察文字与背景同步变化。
Switch only this sample theme; text and surfaces change together.

title: 国际化
Localization
scenario: 比较界面标签的两种语言；用户填写的名称不随之翻译。
Compare UI labels in two languages without translating the entered name.

title: 高对比模式
High contrast
scenario: 增强轮廓对比度，同时保留语义标签。
Increase border contrast while retaining semantic labels.

title: 暗黑模式
Dark mode
scenario: 暗色表面使用三个层级，避免全部纯黑丢失边界。
Three dark surfaces preserve hierarchy instead of using uniform black.

initial_probe.scope: static/semantic specimen; no interaction pass claimed

title: 主要按钮
Primary button
scenario: 创建项目是唯一主操作，取消不竞争同一视觉权重。
Creating a project is the primary action; Cancel is quieter.

title: 次要按钮
Secondary button
scenario: 并列的导入和导出均为次操作，不抢占主流程。
Import and Export are peer secondary actions.

title: 普通按钮
Standard action button
scenario: 普通操作默认有可见边界，激活后显示与该动作对应的结果。
A standard text action has visible boundaries and a specific result.

title: 危险按钮
Destructive button
scenario: 危险动作先说明对象与影响，再明确确认；不能只给一个垃圾桶。
A destructive action names the object and consequence before confirmation.

title: 图标按钮
Icon button
scenario: 搜索与设置采用图标；hover/focus 提供名称，点击打开二级内容。
Search and settings use icons with hover/focus names and secondary content.

title: 分裂按钮
Split button
scenario: 主区保存本地示例草稿，箭头展开真正的 JSON / CSV 文件导出。
The primary segment saves a local specimen draft; the arrow offers real JSON / CSV exports.

title: 下拉按钮
Menu button
scenario: 导出格式由菜单选择，不为每种格式增加顶栏按钮。
Choose an export format in a menu rather than adding top-level buttons.

title: 按钮组
Button group
scenario: 编辑按钮组保持等高；对齐方式是相斥状态。
An edit group keeps equal heights; alignment is mutually exclusive.

title: 切换按钮
Toggle button
scenario: 收藏是可逆切换，按下状态与结果一起更新。
A reversible favorite action updates its pressed state and result.

title: 分段选择
Segmented control
scenario: 网格、列表与紧凑视图共享一个分段控件。
Grid, list and compact layouts share one segmented control.

title: 悬浮按钮
Floating action button
scenario: 悬浮新增仅用于此示例的单一高频动作；不遮挡内容。
One floating action supports a frequent local task without covering content.

title: 加载按钮
Loading button
scenario: 加载时保持宽度与按钮位置，禁止重复提交。
A loading action preserves width and prevents duplicate submissions.

title: 复制操作
Copy action
scenario: 复制操作给出反馈；剪贴板不可用时明确提示，不伪称成功。
Copy reports success or clipboard unavailability, never a false success.

title: 链接按钮
Link button
scenario: 链接执行页面内定位，保持真实链接语义。
A link performs in-page navigation with native link semantics.

initial_probe.scope: static/semantic specimen; no interaction pass claimed

title: 工具栏
Toolbar
scenario: 工作区工具栏优先使用熟悉的图标；详细参数放进设置。
A workspace toolbar uses familiar icons; detailed parameters live in settings.

title: 上下文菜单
Context menu
scenario: 对象菜单提供本地复制、重命名和可撤销移除；不把所有操作铺满卡片。
An object menu provides local copy, rename and undoable removal without crowding the card.

title: 顶部导航
Top navigation
scenario: 顶栏主导航同时显示当前位置和对应页面内容。
Top navigation shows both current location and matching page content.

title: 侧边导航
Side navigation
scenario: 侧边导航将工作区、收藏和归档分开，不把操作按钮混入导航。
Side navigation separates workspace, favorites and archive from actions.

title: 导航轨道
Navigation rail
scenario: 图标轨道只保留熟悉入口，通过提示和选中状态维持方向感。
A compact icon rail relies on familiar symbols, tooltips and selection.

title: 面包屑
Breadcrumbs
scenario: 面包屑显示真实层级，可返回父级而不依赖浏览器后退。
Breadcrumbs show hierarchy and support returning to a parent.

title: 页面标签
Page tabs
scenario: 页面标签共享一组内容区域，并支持方向键、Home、End。
Page tabs share one panel and support arrows, Home and End.

title: 侧栏标签
Sidebar tabs
scenario: 侧栏在文件、搜索和历史之间切换，搜索内容不会丢失。
Sidebar tabs preserve a search draft across Files, Search and History.

title: 分页
Pagination
scenario: 分页只切换数据片段，上一页和下一页的禁用状态准确。
Pagination changes the data slice and disables boundary actions.

title: 步骤导航
Steps
scenario: 步骤导航把当前位置、已完成步骤与未来步骤区分开。
Step navigation distinguishes current, completed and future steps.

title: 锚点导航
Anchor navigation
scenario: 页内锚点在一个可滚动区域中定位具体小节。
In-page anchors locate sections inside a scrollable surface.

title: 目录
Table of contents
scenario: 目录由实际文档小节构成，选中时显示对应摘要。
A table of contents is tied to real document sections and summaries.

title: 命令面板
Command palette
scenario: 命令面板按关键词过滤，选择后给出明确目标。
A command palette filters by keyword and identifies the chosen command.

title: 搜索建议
Search suggestions
scenario: 搜索建议来自本地数据，输入与候选内容保持一致。
Search suggestions come from local data and track the query.

title: 树形导航
Tree navigation
scenario: 多层树通过原生折叠结构展开，叶子对应真实文件名称。
A multilevel tree uses native disclosures and named file leaves.
limits: 此例使用原生 disclosure 树形导航，不冒充已完成 ARIA tree 全键盘合同。
Uses native disclosure navigation; does not claim a complete ARIA tree keyboard contract.

title: 大菜单
Mega menu
scenario: 大菜单按任务分区，避免一长列无分类的链接。
A mega menu groups links by task rather than one long list.

title: 移动底栏
Bottom navigation
scenario: 手机底栏保留三个稳定目的地，图标下方附短标签。
A mobile bottom bar keeps three stable destinations with short labels.

title: 路由守卫
Navigation guard
scenario: 存在未保存内容时导航先确认，取消离开必须保留草稿。
Navigation with unsaved content asks for confirmation and preserves the draft on Cancel.

title: 文本输入
Text field
scenario: 项目标题输入显示字符上限与即时计数。
A project title field shows its limit and live character count.

title: 文本区域
Textarea
scenario: 多行备注保留换行，并显示行数而非改写正文。
A multiline note preserves line breaks and reports the line count.

title: 密码输入
Password field
scenario: 密码字段默认隐藏，可逆显隐不会改变输入值。
A password starts hidden; toggling visibility does not alter its value.

title: 数字输入
Number input
scenario: 数量输入限制在 1–20，越界时不提交。
A quantity is limited to 1–20 and rejects out-of-range submission.

title: 日期选择
Date picker
scenario: 日期输入使用真正的日期值，提交时展示 ISO 日期。
A date field uses a real date value and reports ISO format.
limits: 日历弹出外观由浏览器提供；文本下拉示例使用统一的自定义选择控件。
Calendar popup appearance is browser-provided; text select cases use the shared styled control.

title: 时间选择
Time picker
scenario: 时间值与显示文案分离，按 24 小时格式提交。
The time value is separate from display copy and uses a 24-hour value.

title: 日期范围
Date range
scenario: 范围结束日期不能早于开始日期。
An end date must not precede the start date.

title: 单选按钮
Radio
scenario: 单选使用同一原生组，选项互斥。
Native radios share one name and are mutually exclusive.

title: 复选框
Checkbox
scenario: 多个复选项互相独立，摘要准确反映当前选择。
Independent checkboxes produce an accurate selection summary.

title: 开关
Switch
scenario: 开关表示立即生效的布尔配置，不作为提交按钮。
A switch represents an immediate boolean setting, not form submission.

title: 原生选择框
Select
scenario: 选择器具有一致浮层样式与方向键操作，不依赖系统菜单皮肤。
A select has consistent popup styling and arrow-key support.

title: 组合框
Combobox
scenario: 可输入组合框按前缀过滤，并用键盘选择候选。
An editable combobox filters by prefix and supports keyboard selection.

title: 自动补全
Autocomplete
scenario: 自动补全允许接受建议，也允许保留自己的值。
Autocomplete allows accepting a suggestion or keeping a custom value.
limits: 此例专门演示原生 datalist，候选弹出外观由浏览器决定。
This explicitly demonstrates native datalist; its suggestion popup is browser-provided.

title: 多选
Multi-select
scenario: 多选将已选项保留为可移除标签。
A multi-select retains selections as removable chips.

title: 级联选择
Cascader
scenario: 级联选择根据上级值重建合法下级，避免残留无效组合。
A cascader rebuilds valid child values when its parent changes.

title: 树形选择
Tree select
scenario: 树形选择在层级中选取叶子，结果保留完整路径。
Tree selection picks a leaf and retains the full path.

title: 滑块
Slider
scenario: 滑块输出当前精确值，而不是只提供拖动位置。
A slider exposes its exact value, not only thumb position.

title: 范围滑块
Range slider
scenario: 双端范围始终满足下限不大于上限，并显示有效区间。
A two-ended range enforces lower ≤ upper and displays the interval.

title: 文件上传
File upload
scenario: 选中文件后显示真实名称、大小和 MIME 类型，不上传。
Choosing a file shows its actual name, size and MIME type without upload.

title: 拖放上传
Dropzone
scenario: 拖放区与按钮选择等价，拖入文件后才显示真实选择结果。
Drop and picker paths are equivalent and report actual selected files.

title: 颜色选择
Color picker
scenario: 颜色选择同步更新色块和十六进制值。
A color picker updates both the swatch and hexadecimal value.

title: 评分
Rating
scenario: 评分用明确的 1–5 按钮和选中值，支持键盘直接访问。
Rating uses explicit 1–5 controls with a selected value and keyboard access.

title: 标签编辑
Tag editor
scenario: 标签输入支持新增、去重和移除，不接受空标签。
Tag editing adds, deduplicates and removes non-empty values.

title: 动态字段
Dynamic form fields
scenario: 动态表单行有独立身份，删除一行不改变其他行的值。
Dynamic rows have independent identities; deleting one preserves the others.

title: 富文本输入
Rich text input
scenario: 富文本示例支持选区加粗与导出纯文本，不执行粘贴的脚本。
A rich-text specimen supports bold selection and plain-text export without executing pasted scripts.

title: 表单验证
Validation
scenario: 提交无效邮箱时关联错误说明并聚焦字段，修正后可再次提交。
Invalid email submission links its error and focuses the field; correction is recoverable.

title: 普通表格
Table
scenario: 普通表格展示明确表头、六条真实合成记录和统一行距。
A basic table shows explicit headings, six synthetic records and consistent row spacing.

initial_probe.scope: static/semantic specimen; no interaction pass claimed

title: 排序表格
Sortable table
scenario: 点击延迟表头会按数字排序，而不是按字符串排序。
The latency header sorts numerically, not lexicographically.

title: 筛选表格
Filterable table
scenario: 筛选结果会随状态选择变化，并显示匹配数量。
A status filter updates matching rows and their count.

title: 分页表格
Paginated table
scenario: 分页在保留表头的同时切换数据，页码与禁用状态同步。
Pagination retains headers while changing the row slice and boundary states.

title: 批量操作
Bulk actions
scenario: 批量操作只影响勾选行；零选择时不能执行。
Bulk actions affect only checked rows and are disabled with no selection.

title: 列可见性
Column visibility
scenario: 列选择改变实际表格列，不仅改变按钮外观。
Column visibility changes actual columns, not just button appearance.

title: 冻结列
Pinned columns
scenario: 横向滚动时第一列固定，其他字段在其后移动。
The first column stays pinned while other columns scroll horizontally.

initial_probe.scope: requires targeted gesture/media/assistive-technology check; not a generic action pass

title: 列调整
Column resize
scenario: 拖动分隔器或用方向键改变首列宽度。
Drag the separator or use arrow keys to resize the first column.

initial_probe.scope: requires targeted gesture/media/assistive-technology check; not a generic action pass

title: 可编辑单元格
Editable cells
scenario: 单元格直接编辑后需保存；结果来自输入值而非固定提示。
Editable cells must be saved; the result reflects actual input values.

title: 虚拟表格
Virtualized table
scenario: 1,000 行只渲染当前窗口，滚动后显示正确行号与内容。
A 1,000-row table renders only the visible window and updates row indices on scroll.

initial_probe.scope: requires targeted gesture/media/assistive-technology check; not a generic action pass

title: 树形网格
Tree grid
scenario: 树形网格展示分层行与列，方向键移动单元格，首行可展开。
A treegrid has hierarchical rows and columns; arrows navigate cells and the first row expands.

title: 主从视图
Master detail
scenario: 主列表选择对象后，详情字段必须同步改变。
Selecting a master-list object updates its detail fields.

title: 密度切换
Density switch
scenario: 密度开关统一改变所有数据行，不改动字体到不可读大小。
A density switch changes all row paddings without making text unreadably small.

title: 行展开
Expandable rows
scenario: 每一条可展开行拥有自己的补充内容。
Each expandable row reveals details belonging to that record.

title: 字段说明
Descriptions
scenario: 描述清单使用术语—值配对，不伪装成数据网格。
Descriptions use term–value pairs rather than pretending to be a data grid.

initial_probe.scope: static/semantic specimen; no interaction pass claimed

title: 属性列表
Property list
scenario: 属性面板包含具体值与编辑入口，点击进入二级表单。
A property list shows concrete values and opens a secondary edit form.

title: 统计卡片
Statistics
scenario: 指标卡显示基数、单位与比较基准，悬停可读取精确数据。
Metric cards include units, baselines and precise hover values.

initial_probe.scope: requires targeted gesture/media/assistive-technology check; not a generic action pass

title: 摘要列表
Summary list
scenario: 摘要列表把对象、数量与下一步放在同一行，适合快速浏览。
A summary list pairs objects, counts and next steps for quick scanning.

title: 卡片
Card
scenario: 单卡片包含标题、摘要、状态和明确的详情入口。
A content card includes title, summary, status and a clear details action.

title: 列表
List
scenario: 列表项保留标题、次要信息和尾部动作的对齐。
List items align primary text, secondary information and trailing actions.

title: 图文条目
Media object
scenario: 图文条目让缩略图与标题、说明构成一个整体。
A media object pairs a thumbnail with title and supporting copy.

title: 头像
Avatar
scenario: 头像以尺寸和文字替代图像，仍有可访问名称。
Initial avatars use size and text while retaining accessible names.

initial_probe.scope: static/semantic specimen; no interaction pass claimed

title: 徽标
Badge
scenario: 通知徽标同步显示真实计数，清除后归零。
A notification badge updates an actual count and clears to zero.

title: 状态标签
Status tag
scenario: 状态标签带明确文字，不用颜色作为唯一差异。
Status tags carry text, not color alone.

title: 提示文本
Helper text
scenario: 帮助文字与输入关联，输入时不消失。
Helper text is associated with its input and remains visible while editing.

title: 引用
Quote
scenario: 引文与作者说明独立排版，避免将强调文本误认作交互。
A quote and attribution are distinct and not mistaken for controls.

initial_probe.scope: static/semantic specimen; no interaction pass claimed

title: 代码块
Code block
scenario: 代码块保留缩进与换行，下载内容与显示内容一致。
A code block preserves indentation and downloads the displayed text.

title: 语法高亮
Syntax highlighting
scenario: 语法着色区分关键字、字符串与注释，但文本仍可直接阅读。
Syntax highlighting distinguishes keywords, strings and comments without hiding text.

initial_probe.scope: static/semantic specimen; no interaction pass claimed

title: 图片
Image
scenario: 真实 PNG 资源按容器缩放，并提供有意义的替代文字。
A real PNG scales to its container and has meaningful alternative text.

initial_probe.scope: static/semantic specimen; no interaction pass claimed

title: 图片预览
Image preview
scenario: 缩略图打开单独的大图预览，关闭后回到原焦点。
A thumbnail opens an enlarged preview and returns focus on close.

title: 画廊
Gallery
scenario: 画廊展示不同素材，选择后显示对应标题和大图。
A gallery uses distinct assets and updates the selected image and title.

title: 轮播
Carousel
scenario: 轮播每张内容不同，前后操作和页码同步。
Carousel slides have distinct content with synchronized controls and page indicator.

title: 折叠区
Disclosure
scenario: 折叠区保留摘要，展开后才呈现详细限制。
A disclosure keeps its summary visible and reveals detailed limits on demand.

title: 手风琴
Accordion
scenario: 手风琴一次只展开一个独立问题，避免过长页面。
An accordion opens one distinct question at a time.

title: 时间线
Timeline
scenario: 时间线展示有先后关系的事件与各自时间，不伪造当前执行证据。
A timeline shows ordered fixture events with timestamps, not current execution evidence.

initial_probe.scope: static/semantic specimen; no interaction pass claimed

title: 日历
Calendar
scenario: 月历按真实月份天数生成，选中日期和翻月都有效。
A calendar uses actual month lengths, date selection and month navigation.

title: 描述清单
Description list
scenario: 对象描述用原生 dl/dt/dd 表达，长值仍能换行。
Native dl/dt/dd expresses object descriptions and wraps long values.

initial_probe.scope: static/semantic specimen; no interaction pass claimed

title: 二维码
QR code
scenario: 二维码真实编码固定样例字符串；下方提供同等文本。
A real QR code encodes a fixed sample string with a text equivalent below.

initial_probe.scope: static/semantic specimen; no interaction pass claimed

title: 空状态
Empty state
scenario: 空状态说明缺少什么，点击后真正创建本地案例内容。
An empty state explains what is missing and creates local case content when activated.

title: 行内提示
Inline notice
scenario: 行内提示紧邻相关配置，不替代字段标签。
An inline notice sits near its setting without replacing the field label.

title: 状态提示
Status message
scenario: 后台状态通过 live region 播报，结果不是仅靠颜色显示。
A live region announces operation status with explicit text.

title: 警告
Alert
scenario: 警告说明具体风险与恢复动作，允许用户继续处理。
A warning explains a specific risk and a recovery action.

title: 验证错误
Validation error
scenario: 错误消息指出字段和修复方式，保留用户已输入内容。
A validation error identifies the field and remedy while preserving input.

title: 成功反馈
Success feedback
scenario: 成功反馈说明完成对象，并允许继续查看结果。
Success feedback identifies what completed and offers a next step.

title: 通知
Notification
scenario: 通知可逐条标记已读，不影响其他通知。
Notifications can be marked read independently.

title: 轻提示
Toast
scenario: 短暂提示确认一个已完成的轻量操作，不遮挡固定工具栏。
A toast confirms a completed lightweight action without covering fixed tools.

title: 全局横幅
Banner
scenario: 全局横幅传达跨页面信息，关闭只影响展示状态。
A banner communicates cross-page information; dismissing only changes display.

title: 进度条
Progress bar
scenario: 进度有明确数值与完成上限；点击推进与重置。
A progress bar has a value and upper limit, with advance and reset controls.

title: 环形进度
Circular progress
scenario: 环形进度同时显示数字与可访问进度值。
Circular progress provides both visible and accessible numeric values.

title: 加载指示
Spinner
scenario: 不确定进度用加载指示而不是伪造百分比。
Indeterminate loading uses a spinner, not a fabricated percentage.

title: 骨架屏
Skeleton
scenario: 只有“骨架屏”这个案例使用占位形状，加载后替换为真实内容。
Only this skeleton-specific case uses placeholders and replaces them with real content.

title: 加载占位
Loading placeholder
scenario: 加载占位保留区域尺寸，完成后内容不会挤压周边元素。
A loading placeholder reserves space so the finished content does not crowd nearby elements.

title: 错误页
Error state
scenario: 错误状态包含可重试动作，重试后显示对应结果。
An error state includes a retry action that reveals the result.

title: 无数据状态
No results
scenario: 无匹配结果和完全无数据是不同状态，清除筛选可恢复结果。
No matches differs from no data; clearing filters restores results.

title: 确认反馈
Confirmation
scenario: 确认反馈说明将保存的目标，取消保持不变。
A confirmation names the save target; Cancel leaves it unchanged.

title: 撤销反馈
Undo feedback
scenario: 撤销只恢复本次动作的对象，不影响其他案例。
Undo restores only the object changed by this action.

title: 离线提示
Offline banner
scenario: 离线状态明确提示使用缓存，并支持恢复在线状态的模拟。
An offline state explains cached content and supports simulated reconnection.

title: 保存状态
Save status
scenario: 编辑后状态变为未保存，保存按钮操作后才恢复已保存。
Editing marks the value unsaved; only Save restores the saved state.

title: 下拉菜单
Dropdown
scenario: 下拉操作菜单锚定触发按钮，支持键盘上下移动。
A dropdown action menu is anchored to its trigger and supports arrow-key navigation.

title: 浮层
Popover
scenario: 非模态浮层承载轻量参数，点击外部可关闭。
A non-modal popover holds lightweight parameters and dismisses on outside click.

title: 提示气泡
Tooltip
scenario: 提示由 hover 或焦点触发，可用 Esc 关闭；不包含交互控件。
A tooltip opens on hover or focus, dismisses with Escape, and contains no controls.

title: 模态框
Modal dialog
scenario: 模态框在短暂编辑任务中限制焦点，关闭后恢复触发焦点。
A modal contains focus for a short edit task and restores its trigger on close.

title: 警告对话框
Alert dialog
scenario: 警告对话框明确操作后果，并把取消作为安全出口。
An alert dialog explains consequences and provides a safe cancel path.

title: 确认框
Confirm dialog
scenario: 确认框摘要展示提交对象，而不要求用户猜“确定”是什么意思。
A confirmation summarizes the target rather than relying on an ambiguous OK.

title: 侧滑抽屉
Drawer
scenario: 抽屉从侧边提供对象详情，保持原页面上下文。
A side drawer provides object details while preserving page context.

title: 底部弹层
Bottom sheet
scenario: 底部弹层用于移动端短任务，内容不过度占据高度。
A bottom sheet supports a short mobile task without occupying excessive height.

title: 上下文菜单
Context menu
scenario: 对象的更多操作使用轻量菜单，不中断主页面。
Object overflow actions use a lightweight menu without blocking the page.

title: 右键菜单
Right-click menu
scenario: 右键与 Shift+F10 都能打开同一上下文菜单。
Right-click and Shift+F10 open the same context menu.

initial_probe.scope: requires targeted gesture/media/assistive-technology check; not a generic action pass

title: 悬浮预览
Hover preview
scenario: 悬浮预览显示真实缩略图和文件信息，可通过点击或聚焦访问。
A hover preview shows an actual thumbnail and metadata, with click/focus access.

title: 命令面板
Command dialog
scenario: 命令对话框提供可搜索目标并执行本地选择。
A command dialog searches targets and performs a local selection.

title: 全屏对话框
Full-screen dialog
scenario: 全屏对话框用于需要空间的检查，保留明显退出入口。
A large dialog provides space for inspection with a clear exit.

title: 引导浮层
Coachmark
scenario: 引导提示明确指向当前控件，且允许立即关闭。
A coachmark points to a specific control and can be dismissed immediately.

title: 气泡菜单
Floating menu
scenario: 浮动菜单靠近编辑对象，只显示当前相关动作。
A floating menu stays near its editing target with contextual actions only.

title: 游览指引
Product tour
scenario: 三步产品引导依次说明搜索、预览和导出，可随时退出。
A three-step tour explains search, preview and export and can be exited anytime.

title: 页面框架
App shell
scenario: 应用骨架分清全局导航、页内导航和内容操作。
An app shell separates global navigation, local navigation and content actions.

title: 页头
Page header
scenario: 页头保留标题、状态与少量高频操作，详情放入二级界面。
A page header retains title, status and a few frequent actions; details stay secondary.

title: 页脚
Footer
scenario: 页脚同时容纳范围说明与分页，两端对齐且不会贴住表格。
A footer aligns a range summary with pagination and keeps a gap from the table.

title: 多栏布局
Multi-column
scenario: 三栏各自有内容职责；窄屏时按顺序堆叠。
Three columns have distinct responsibilities and stack on narrow screens.

initial_probe.scope: static/semantic specimen; no interaction pass claimed

title: 侧栏
Sidebar
scenario: 侧栏只承载局部目录，不与主体内容竞争宽度。
A sidebar holds a local outline without competing with the main content.

title: 可交换侧栏
Swappable sidebar
scenario: 交换物理位置不会交换“资源”和“检查器”的逻辑内容。
Swapping physical positions preserves Explorer and Inspector identities.

title: 分栏
Split pane
scenario: 分栏比例是可调整参数，两个区域都有最小可用宽度。
A split pane has an adjustable ratio with minimum usable widths.

title: 分隔器
Splitter
scenario: 真实分隔器支持拖拽与方向键，不以装饰线替代交互。
A real splitter supports drag and arrow keys rather than acting as decoration.

initial_probe.scope: requires targeted gesture/media/assistive-technology check; not a generic action pass

title: 停靠面板
Dockable panel
scenario: 面板可停靠两侧或以浮层查看；状态与面板内容不分离。
A panel can dock on either side or open as a floating view while retaining content.
limits: 此例演示停靠状态切换，不声明实现完整 IDE 拖拽停靠系统。
Demonstrates docking-state changes, not a complete IDE drag-docking system.

title: 可折叠侧栏
Collapsible sidebar
scenario: 折叠侧栏后保留可恢复入口，而不是永久隐藏导航。
Collapsing a sidebar retains a visible restoration control.

title: 多页签工作区
Multi-document workspace
scenario: 多文档工作区可新增、切换和关闭标签，关闭后选取相邻项。
A multi-document workspace adds, switches and closes tabs, choosing a neighbor on close.

title: 卡片网格
Card grid
scenario: 卡片网格内部布局一致，标题长度变化不造成按钮错位。
Cards share a consistent internal layout so varying titles do not misalign actions.

title: 瀑布流
Masonry
scenario: 瀑布流使用不同长度的真实内容，不用空白块模拟。
A masonry layout uses content of differing lengths rather than empty blocks.

initial_probe.scope: static/semantic specimen; no interaction pass claimed

title: 虚拟滚动
Virtual list
scenario: 长列表按滚动窗口渲染，避免同时创建全部条目节点。
A long list renders the scroll window rather than all item nodes.

initial_probe.scope: requires targeted gesture/media/assistive-technology check; not a generic action pass

title: 响应式抽屉
Responsive drawer
scenario: 窄屏细节以抽屉打开，避免常驻侧栏挤压主体。
On narrow screens, details open on demand instead of shrinking the main content.

title: 分步表单布局
Wizard layout
scenario: 分步表单将进度导航、字段和提交区各自分组并留白。
A wizard layout separates progress, fields and submission actions with spacing.

title: 详情页面
Detail page
scenario: 详情页整合身份、状态、元数据与相关对象，而不只显示一张表。
A detail page combines identity, status, metadata and related objects.

initial_probe.scope: static/semantic specimen; no interaction pass claimed

title: 仪表盘
Dashboard
scenario: 仪表盘将统计与趋势放在一起，时间范围切换有真实数值变化。
A dashboard pairs metrics with trends and changes actual values with the period.

title: 柱形图
Bar chart
scenario: 柱形图按星期比较完成数量，每根柱子都可读取精确值。
A bar chart compares weekday completions; every bar exposes an exact value.

title: 折线图
Line chart
scenario: 折线图比较五次发布的时延，数据点可通过键盘聚焦。
A line chart compares latency across five releases with focusable data points.

title: 面积图
Area chart
scenario: 面积图表达连续区间的会话数量，并保留每个采样点。
An area chart shows session counts over intervals while retaining every sample point.

title: 饼图
Pie chart
scenario: 饼图每个扇区的数值与比例一致，图例同时显示名称。
Pie sectors match their values and proportions, with labeled legend entries.

title: 环形图
Donut chart
scenario: 环形图显示总量与组成，中心数字等于各项求和。
A donut shows composition and a total equal to the sum of its segments.

title: 散点图
Scatter plot
scenario: 散点图显示 X/Y 数值对；悬停显示两轴的值而非单一总数。
Scatter points reveal both X and Y values rather than a single total.

title: 热力图
Heatmap
scenario: 热力图每个格子都有周、日和数量，颜色不是唯一信息来源。
Every heatmap cell exposes week, day and count; color is not the only information.

title: 树图
Treemap
scenario: 树图用面积表示存储占比，标签与精确比例同时可见。
Treemap area represents storage share, with labels and exact percentages.

title: 漏斗图
Funnel
scenario: 漏斗宽度对应每步转化比例，读数不依赖形状猜测。
Funnel widths correspond to conversion percentages with exact readings.

title: 甘特图
Gantt
scenario: 甘特条表示真实起止日，悬停显示持续时间。
Gantt bars encode start/end days and expose durations on hover.

title: 时间序列
Time series
scenario: 时间序列的采样顺序与时间标签一致。
Time-series samples follow their time labels in order.

title: 迷你趋势图
Sparkline
scenario: 迷你趋势图作为指标补充，仍能检查各采样值。
A sparkline complements a metric while retaining inspectable sample values.

title: 数据地图
Data map
scenario: 区域数据图使用明确标注的合成区域，不冒充真实地图。
A regional data map uses explicitly synthetic zones, not a real geographic map.

title: 网络拓扑
Network diagram
scenario: 网络拓扑中的每个节点显示自身延迟，而不是通用提示。
Each network node exposes its own latency, not a generic tooltip.

title: 桑基图
Sankey
scenario: 桑基连线显示具体流量，并在分支保持数量守恒。
Sankey links expose flow quantities and conserve counts at branches.

title: 坐标画布
Coordinate canvas
scenario: 坐标画布中的点有明确正负坐标，点击可选择一个数据点。
Points have signed coordinates and can be selected by clicking.

title: 图例
Legend
scenario: 图例控制对应数据系列的显示；可同时对照 A、B，取消勾选只隐藏对应系列。
A legend controls each matching series independently; A and B can be compared together.

title: 交互筛选
Cross-filter
scenario: 点击图表分类后，下方明细表筛选到对应分类。
Selecting a chart category filters the detail table to that category.

title: 图表工具提示
Chart tooltip
scenario: 工具提示包含日期、系列与精确数值，且同样支持焦点触发。
Chart tooltips contain period, series and exact value and also work on focus.

title: 多步向导
Wizard
scenario: 多步向导验证必填值，前后切换保留已填内容。
A multi-step wizard validates required fields and preserves values while navigating.

title: 看板
Kanban
scenario: 看板支持按钮与拖放两条等价的状态迁移路径。
A kanban supports equivalent button and drag/drop paths for moving tasks.

title: 状态机
State machine
scenario: 状态机只允许合法迁移，未审核时无法直接批准。
A state machine allows valid transitions only; Draft cannot jump directly to Approved.

title: 任务清单
Task list
scenario: 任务清单显示已完成数量，切换任一项同步更新汇总。
A task list updates its completed count when any task changes.

title: 流程图
Flowchart
scenario: 流图节点有名称与方向，编辑入口打开真正可操作的画布。
Flowchart nodes have names and direction, with an entry to an actual editable canvas.

title: 审批流
Approval workflow
scenario: 审批流的同意与驳回产生不同结果，反馈不能混淆。
Approve and Reject lead to distinct outcomes in an approval flow.

title: 评论线程
Comment thread
scenario: 评论线程显示作者和回复层级，新增评论保留输入内容。
A comment thread shows authors and reply hierarchy and retains added text.

title: 版本历史
Version history
scenario: 版本历史显示每版实际内容，恢复只改变当前案例值。
Version history reveals actual revision content; Restore affects only this case.

title: 变更对比
Diff viewer
scenario: 变更对比保留前后两份内容，并明确新增与删除。
A diff retains both versions and clearly identifies additions and removals.

initial_probe.scope: static/semantic specimen; no interaction pass claimed

title: 活动记录
Activity log
scenario: 活动记录记录实际点击生成的本地事件，而不是固定成功提示。
An activity log records local events created by actual clicks, not fixed success copy.

title: 命令撤销
Undo stack
scenario: 撤销栈支持多次修改与重做，新修改会清空重做分支。
An undo stack supports multiple edits and redo; new edits clear the redo branch.

title: 批处理任务
Batch jobs
scenario: 批处理逐项更新状态，失败与完成不能合并成一个总成功。
Batch jobs track each item separately rather than collapsing failure and completion into one success.

title: 进度跟踪
Progress tracking
scenario: 进度跟踪显示每个工作包的状态，而不只显示单一总百分比。
Progress tracking shows each work package, not only one overall percentage.

title: 任务依赖
Dependencies
scenario: 依赖未完成时下游任务不可开始，并说明阻塞原因。
A dependent task cannot start before its prerequisite completes, with a visible reason.

title: 预约日历
Scheduling calendar
scenario: 预约日程只修改本案例，时间槽重复时拒绝覆盖。
A scheduling specimen edits only local data and rejects duplicate time slots.

title: 操作审计
Audit trail
scenario: 审计事件明确动作、对象、结果和来源是本地样例。
An audit event records action, object, result and its local-fixture origin.

initial_probe.scope: static/semantic specimen; no interaction pass claimed

title: 冲突解决
Conflict resolution
scenario: 冲突解决保留本地与远端候选，选择后展示明确合并结果。
Conflict resolution retains local and remote candidates and shows the chosen result.

title: 任务重试
Retry flow
scenario: 重试有次数与独立结果，首次失败后第二次才成功。
Retries have attempt counts and distinct outcomes: first fails, second succeeds.

title: 高级搜索
Advanced search
scenario: 高级搜索组合关键词、负责人和状态，返回实际匹配记录。
Advanced search combines keyword, owner and status to return actual matches.

title: 筛选构建器
Filter builder
scenario: 筛选构建器把字段、运算符和值分开，应用后真正过滤数据。
A filter builder separates field, operator and value and really filters records.

title: 规则构建器
Rule builder
scenario: 规则构建将条件与结果分离，可用输入值测试规则。
A rule builder separates condition and outcome and can test an input value.

title: 查询构建器
Query builder
scenario: 查询构建器生成 SQL 文本但不连接数据库，也不执行输入。
A query builder generates SQL text without connecting to or executing against a database.

title: 权限矩阵
Permission matrix
scenario: 权限矩阵逐项编辑，并明确这只是 UI 状态，不是访问控制系统。
A permission matrix edits individual cells and is clearly UI state, not an access-control system.

title: 批量编辑
Bulk edit
scenario: 批量编辑先预览差异，再确认应用到选中行。
Bulk editing previews changes before applying them to selected rows.

title: 行内编辑
Inline edit
scenario: 行内编辑有保存与取消，取消不会改变已提交值。
Inline editing supports Save and Cancel; Cancel preserves the committed value.

title: 多角色视图
Role-based views
scenario: 切换角色后可见能力对应变化，并保留权限解释。
Role changes update visible capabilities and retain permission explanations.

title: 复杂树表
Hierarchical grid
scenario: 层次数据按部门展开，并显示对应小计，避免复制同一平表。
Hierarchical data expands by department and shows matching subtotals.

title: 导入映射
Import mapping
scenario: 导入映射将来源列对应到目标字段，重复目标映射会被拒绝。
Import mapping maps source columns to target fields and rejects duplicate targets.

title: 数据透视
Pivot table
scenario: 数据透视按所选维度计算聚合值，不展示固定假汇总。
A pivot table computes aggregates for the selected dimension.

title: 对象详情页
Object page
scenario: 对象页的概要、关系与活动各自拥有真实内容。
An object page provides distinct overview, relationships and activity content.

title: 分析列表
Analytical list
scenario: 分析列表把聚合图与明细筛选关联到同一状态。
An analytical list keeps the aggregate chart and detail filter in one state.

title: 工作流设计器
Workflow designer
scenario: 工作流设计器直接使用本轮真实画布引擎，而非静态节点截图。
The workflow designer uses the actual canvas engine, not a static node screenshot.
limits: 画布编辑真实可用；运行按钮是本地模拟，不调用模型或 Dify/ComfyUI 服务。
Canvas edits are real; Run is local simulation and does not call a model or Dify/ComfyUI service.

title: 富文本编辑器
Rich text editor
scenario: 文档编辑器支持标题、正文和即时预览，内容不会因界面语言而被翻译。
A document editor has a title, body and live preview; UI language does not translate content.

title: 代码编辑器
Code editor
scenario: 代码编辑器显示源码与行数，整理空白不执行代码。
A code editor shows source and line count; whitespace cleanup does not execute code.

title: JSON 编辑器
JSON editor
scenario: JSON 编辑器严格解析输入，错误时不替换原文本。
A JSON editor parses strictly and retains original text on error.

title: 图谱编辑
Graph editor
scenario: 依赖图可以新增、删改、连线和撤销，使用独立样例状态。
A dependency graph supports real add/edit/delete/connect/undo with independent case state.

title: 交互白板
Collaborative canvas
scenario: 协作画布显示两个明确标注的本地模拟光标，不能冒充真实在线用户。
A collaborative-canvas specimen labels two simulated cursors, not real online users.

initial_probe.scope: requires targeted gesture/media/assistive-technology check; not a generic action pass

title: 资源调度
Resource planner
scenario: 资源计划按资源与时间检查槽位冲突，分配后更新对应单元格。
Check resource/time conflicts and update the exact assigned cell.

title: 对比视图
Compare view
scenario: 对比视图逐字段比对，可隐藏完全相同的字段。
A comparison view contrasts fields and can hide unchanged rows.

title: 文件树
File tree
scenario: 文件树包含不同格式，叶子选择会报告准确路径。
A file tree contains different formats and reports the selected full path.

title: 路径导航
Path navigation
scenario: 路径导航可返回父文件夹，列表内容随路径同步变化。
Path navigation returns to parent folders and updates the file list.

title: 文件卡片
File card
scenario: 文件卡片显示真实格式与尺寸，不把所有文件显示为文档。
A file card identifies its actual format and dimensions, not a generic document.

title: 上传队列
Upload queue
scenario: 多文件队列显示每个真实选择文件的状态，可移除单项。
A multi-file queue tracks each chosen file and can remove individual entries.

title: 上传进度
Upload progress
scenario: 本地文件读取进度来自 FileReader，不伪造网络上传进度。
Local file-read progress comes from FileReader, not a fabricated network upload.

title: 媒体播放器
Media player
scenario: 媒体播放器在真实的合成视频与音频资源间切换。
A media player switches between actual bundled synthetic video and audio.

title: 音频播放器
Audio player
scenario: 音频播放速率与原生控件协同，显示当前倍率。
Audio playback rate works with native controls and displays its current multiplier.

title: 视频控制
Video controls
scenario: 视频按钮实际控制播放、暂停与静音；不以固定图标假装播放器。
Video buttons really control play, pause and mute rather than simulating a player with icons.

title: 图片标注
Image annotation
scenario: 图像批注按真实点击位置记录归一化坐标。
Image annotation records normalized coordinates from actual clicks.

title: 文件预览
File preview
scenario: 预览入口根据格式使用 JSON 文本、CSV 表格或位图查看器。
A preview entry selects JSON text, a CSV table or a bitmap viewer by format.

title: 文档查看器
Document viewer
scenario: 分页面板展示三页不同的文档内容，页码对应当前页。
A paged document specimen shows distinct content on three pages with a matching page number.
limits: 这是逻辑分页文档样例，不是 PDF 解析器。
This is a logical document-pagination specimen, not a PDF parser.

title: 缩略图
Thumbnail
scenario: 缩略图选择状态对应下方预览，不重复显示同一占位图。
Thumbnail selection matches the preview and uses distinct assets.

title: 拖放区域
Drop target
scenario: 拖放目标只接受文件，并显示文件信息；普通文字拖入不会冒充文件。
A drop target accepts files and reports their details, not arbitrary dragged text.

initial_probe.scope: requires targeted gesture/media/assistive-technology check; not a generic action pass

title: 附件列表
Attachments
scenario: 附件列表能导出匹配格式的内容，并能移除指定附件。
Attachments export matching native content and can remove a specific attachment.

title: 文件版本
File versions
scenario: 文件版本展示实际大小和内容，选中版本可另存为独立文件。
File versions show actual content and size and can export the selected revision separately.

title: 导出设置
Export options
scenario: 导出选项决定文件格式与列头，产物和选项相匹配。
Export options determine the format and headers, and the produced file matches them.

title: 用户菜单
Account menu
scenario: 账户入口显示模拟身份，菜单操作不会退出真实账户。
An account menu shows a simulated identity and never signs out a real account.

title: 登录表单
Sign-in form
scenario: 登录表单只校验样例字段，不认证、不发送、不存储真实密码。
A sign-in form validates fixture fields without authentication, transmission or real password storage.

title: 多因素验证
MFA
scenario: MFA 样例验证六位输入格式；固定样例码不是安全认证。
An MFA specimen validates six digits; its fixed demo code is not authentication.

title: 邀请协作者
Invite collaborators
scenario: 邀请表单显示接收人和角色，提交仅添加本地预览条目。
An invitation form shows recipient and role and adds only a local preview entry.

title: 在线状态
Presence
scenario: 在线状态使用文字与状态点，且明确这是模拟存在感。
Presence combines text and status dots and is explicitly simulated.

title: 头像组
Avatar group
scenario: 头像组折叠超额成员，点击数量能看到完整名单。
An avatar group collapses overflow members and reveals the full roster through its count.

title: 消息提醒
Mention notice
scenario: 提及提醒说明谁提及了什么内容，并提供定位入口。
A mention notice explains who mentioned what and offers a location action.

title: 评论
Comments
scenario: 评论可新增和删除自己的本地条目，不影响其他人的示例内容。
Comments can add or remove your local entries without changing fixture comments by others.

title: 批注
Annotations
scenario: 批注关联到一个明确文本片段，弹层展示该片段与备注。
An annotation attaches to a specific text fragment and shows it alongside the note.

title: 冲突提示
Conflict notice
scenario: 冲突提示保留两份值并说明变更来源，不能静默覆盖。
A conflict notice retains both values and identifies their source instead of overwriting silently.

title: 角色管理
Role management
scenario: 角色管理逐人编辑并明确权限来源是本地模拟。
Role management edits each participant separately and is clearly a local simulation.

title: 共享设置
Sharing controls
scenario: 分享范围与到期时间在二级设置中明确呈现，不自动创建公开链接。
Sharing scope and expiry are explicit and never create a public link automatically.

title: 审计事件
Audit event
scenario: 审核事件同时保留对象、操作者、前值和后值。
An audit event retains object, actor, previous value and new value.

title: 协作光标
Collaborative cursor
scenario: 协作光标显示姓名和坐标；演示位置变化，不声称真实同步。
A collaborative cursor shows a label and coordinates; movement is simulated, not synchronized.

title: 通知中心
Notification center
scenario: 通知中心保留已读状态，再次打开仍显示准确计数。
A notification center retains read state and shows an accurate count when reopened.

title: 键盘焦点
Keyboard focus
scenario: 用 Tab 检查真实焦点，而非画一圈假焦点
Use Tab to inspect actual keyboard focus, not a decorative ring

title: 焦点陷阱
Focus trap
scenario: 模态框里的焦点循环与关闭后的焦点返回
Modal focus cycling and return to the invoking control

title: 跳过导航
Skip link
scenario: 跳过重复导航，直接聚焦正文入口
Skip repeated navigation and focus the content entry

title: 状态播报
Live region
scenario: 计数变化通过 polite live region 播报
Announce count changes through a polite live region

title: ARIA 标签
Accessible name
scenario: 同样的无框图标，具有明确的可访问名称
Frameless icons with explicit accessible names

title: 高对比度
High contrast
scenario: 提高样例边界与文字对比，不改变用户数据
Increase specimen contrast without changing user data

title: 字体放大
Text resize
scenario: 放大文本至 200%，观察换行和控件高度
Resize text to 200% and inspect wrapping and control growth

title: 减少动效
Reduced motion
scenario: 减少动效时保留状态变化的文字结果
Preserve textual state changes when reduced motion is enabled

title: 触屏目标
Touch target
scenario: 比较触控命中区，而不缩小图标本身
Compare touch hit areas without shrinking the icon

title: 屏幕阅读器语义
Screen reader semantics
scenario: 语义来自真实元素，不是截图外观
Semantics come from real elements, not a screenshot

initial_probe.scope: static/semantic specimen; no interaction pass claimed

title: 键盘导航
Keyboard navigation
scenario: 工具栏方向键移动焦点，与 Tab 进入退出分离
Arrow keys move toolbar focus; Tab enters and leaves

title: 错误提示关联
Error association
scenario: 错误文字通过 aria-describedby 关联到原输入
Associate an error with its original input using aria-describedby

title: 移动导航
Mobile navigation
scenario: 小屏导航按需打开，关闭后回到触发器
Open navigation on demand and return focus when closed

title: 平板布局
Tablet layout
scenario: 平板横竖屏使用真实重新排版，而不是缩小截图
Reflow tablet orientation instead of shrinking a screenshot

title: 离线回退
Offline fallback
scenario: 模拟离线回退保留最近缓存并明确时间
Simulated offline fallback retains a timestamped local fixture

title: RTL 排版
Right-to-left layout
scenario: RTL 使用方向属性，但代码和数值保持自己的方向
Use dir for RTL while code and numbers retain their own direction

title: 聊天消息
Chat message
scenario: 聊天记录分角色显示，发送后追加本地固定回复
Show message roles and append a deterministic local reply

title: 流式输出
Streaming response
scenario: 流式文字可停止，输出来源明确标记为固定文本
Stop streamed fixture text and label its deterministic source

title: 工具调用
Tool call
scenario: 工具卡片展开输入与输出，不把预览当执行
Expand tool inputs and output without claiming execution

title: 来源引用
Source citation
scenario: 来源编号能打开对应片段，并标明合成来源
Open the cited excerpt and label it as synthetic

title: 模型选择
Model picker
scenario: 模型选项展示能力差异和未连接状态
Model choices expose capability differences and disconnected status

title: 提示词输入
Prompt composer
scenario: 变量插值预览保留原始提示词，不调用模型
Preview variable interpolation without changing the prompt or calling a model

title: 上下文附件
Context attachments
scenario: 附件明确显示本地文件名和字节，不虚构 token 数
Show local attachment names and bytes without inventing token counts

title: 思考进度
Reasoning status
scenario: 显示任务阶段，不制造内部思考过程
Show task stages without fabricating internal reasoning

title: 审批请求
Action approval
scenario: 先展示变更和影响，批准后仅更新本地草案
Preview scope and changes before updating a local draft

title: 执行日志
Execution log
scenario: 日志记录实际点击步骤，并可按级别过滤
Record actual local actions and filter log severity

title: 运行轨迹
Run trace
scenario: 运行轨迹展开每一步的输入输出与耗时标签
Expand a fixture run trace with inputs, outputs, and labeled sample timing

title: 差异补丁
Patch diff
scenario: 差异能应用到本地文本，也能恢复原文
Apply a diff to local text and restore the original

title: 终端
Terminal
scenario: 终端只执行列明的本地演示命令，不访问系统
Terminal accepts allowlisted demo commands only, never the system shell

title: 代码单元
Code cell
scenario: 代码单元演示受限算术解释器，不使用 eval
A code-cell specimen uses a restricted arithmetic parser, not eval

title: 测试报告
Test report
scenario: 测试报告基于本地样例断言重算，不伪造工程 PASS
Recompute fixture assertions rather than inventing project test results

title: 能力缺失提示
Capability fallback
scenario: 能力缺失时说明不可做什么，并提供真实本地替代
Explain unavailable capabilities and provide a real local fallback

title: 权限确认
Permission confirmation
scenario: 权限确认列明对象、范围和撤销方式
Permission confirmation names the object, scope and revocation path
